name: AIList
description: AIList groups related AIListItems under a section heading with optional leading icon, count badge, intro narrative paragraph, and a collapse/expand toggle. Items can render as a vertical stack (default), a 2-up grid (for change/grid layouts), or a compact stack (for side panels and drawers). The section can show loading, empty, error, updating, data-stale, or no-changes states so a single component spans the full briefing lifecycle.
intent: Section wrapper for AI-led narrative lists.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: items

props.hint: Section state — default / loading / empty / updating / dataStale / error / noChanges.
